contract.overview_summary: Weekly Overview stays a summary; new summary rows derived from Posts rows carry the technical key in column U (_row_key). Legacy overview rows are retained untouched. Platforms without an overview column (X, Google Business Profile, unfamiliar labels) appear only in the Posts table — no generic-platform fallback into TikTok or any named column.
contract.idempotency_contract: Read Posts!A1:N including header and verify company before writes; keyed readback/upsert for all tabs. Caller must serialize each company/sheet operation with its durable claim. Non-idempotent append HTTP calls are never blindly retried; failures return repair receipts, and replay starts with readback.

repair_contract.verification: F14 — BEFORE any write, spreadsheet metadata is read with the SAME googleSheetsOAuth2Api credential the append uses, and the expected tab is checked. A 404 (Requested entity was not found: nonexistent or deleted sheet ID) classifies as repair_state 'sheet_not_found' (identity repair); a 403 classifies as 'sheet_access_denied' (access repair). Neither is ever answered by silently creating a replacement sheet.
repair_contract.transient: 5xx/429/network failures are transient: bounded retries (retryOnFail, maxTries 3, 2s backoff), then a failed receipt carrying repair_state 'transient' for the caller to re-queue.
repair_contract.replay: Pending keyed rows live in the caller's durable ledger (F15) under the SAME row_key. Once verified access is restored, the caller replays each pending row exactly once — the readback upsert updates the existing keyed row in place and never duplicates it, so history is retained.

error_schema.repair_action: specific actionable repair instruction (identity vs access)

asset_manifest_contract.purpose: F24 — persist one asset-manifest record per image asset and write trusted =IMAGE("https://…",1) formulas ONLY into the Images tab's designated preview columns. The Posts tab keeps preview_url as RAW (F26 rule: untrusted URLs never become formulas).
asset_manifest_contract.image_formula_rule: The Images write node wraps ONLY caller-validated URLs: https, no quotes/backslashes/control chars, a Sheets-fetchable image host (assets.cdn.filesafe.space/... or an equivalent permanent CDN). Drive page links and soon-expiring URLs are rejected into a repair state, never written.
asset_manifest_contract.formula: =IMAGE("<preview_url>", 1) written into Images tab preview columns only; adjacent fields (content id, ratio, alt) stay RAW values.
asset_manifest_contract.sizing: New Images preview columns 220px and new asset rows 275px; replays preserve existing client dimensions. Dimension field masks required.
asset_manifest_contract.broken_url: A formula written for an unreachable/expired URL surfaces a visible repair state (asset_broken) in the receipt; it is never silently dropped.

input_schema.title: string (optional, feeds the overview summary)
input_schema.asset: object (optional, F24 — {content_id, asset_id, kind, preview_url, original_url, ratio, width, height, alt_text, qc_state}; kind=image writes the Images manifest row + trusted =IMAGE formula; kind=video writes the Videos row with poster + Watch video link (F38))

credential_references: googleSheetsOAuth2Api — select the operator Google Sheets credential on every Google Sheets API node (re-wire after import; never committed).
